title: The legal issues to which each offense belongs

verses.t: When it comes to the offenses for a lustful nun consenting to a lustful man making physical contact with her, to which of the four kinds of legal issues do they belong? They belong to legal issues arising from an offense. …
When it comes to the offenses for asking for curd and then eating it, to which of the four kinds of legal issues do they belong? They belong to legal issues arising from an offense.
The legal issues to which each offense belongs, the sixth, are finished.
